Message:
drm/amdgpu: Skip access GRBM_CNTL under SRIOV on gfx_v11

[Why]
GRBM_CNTL is a PF_only register on gfx_v11.
RLCG interface will return "out of range" under SRIOV VF.

[How]
Skip access GRBM_CNTL under gfx_v11 SRIOV VF.
